title: Block malicious destinations at creation and on every redirect
description: Clarified by the product owner after review: blocking must also disable links that already exist, because the phishing links reported by customers were created before the domains were known to be bad. Performance work stays deferred.
acceptance_criteria: Operators configure blocked domains with APP_BLOCKED_DOMAINS (comma-separated)
A blocked domain also blocks all of its subdomains, case-insensitively
Creating a link to a blocked destination returns 422 'destination domain is blocked'
Lookalike domains (e.g. phish.example.org for phish.example) are not blocked
Existing links to a blocked destination stop redirecting and return 410 'destination has been blocked', including links already in the redirect cache

ambiguities.question: 'More secure' against what threat: abuse by link creators, account takeover, or data exposure?
ambiguities.proposed_default: Abuse: stop the shortener from fronting phishing/malware destinations, using an operator-managed domain denylist

ambiguities.question: Should blocking also disable links that already exist?
ambiguities.proposed_default: Yes (decided by product owner): enforce on every redirect, cached links included

ambiguities.question: 'Faster' for which operation, and what is the target?
ambiguities.proposed_default: No change now: redirects for hot links are already served from the in-process cache; measure p95/p99 before optimising

assumptions: Denylist is small (hundreds of domains) and changes via deployment config
Blocked links return 410, consistent with expired links
non_functional: Denylist check adds negligible latency (set lookup per label)
